title: The Resurrection Body
lead: What kind of body the dead will have when they are raised. Paul's answer in 1 Corinthians 15:35-49 is that it is a real body, but changed: raised in what cannot decay, in glory and power, a spiritual body fitted to the age to come. Churches and scholars differ on how much it is the same body, where the dead are until then, and what 'spiritual' means.
